movie.title: Say Less
movie.overview: Left home alone while their parents are out of town, teenage siblings Cassie and Max see their petty sibling warfare take a dark turn when they make a shocking discovery about their father.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Left home alone for the weekend, teenage siblings Cassie and Max discover a disturbing secret about their father that threatens to transform their everyday petty rivalry into something far more dangerous.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Teenage siblings Cassie and Max are left to their own devices when their parents head out of town for the weekend. What begins as typical, lighthearted sibling bickering quickly shifts into high-stakes tension after they uncover a shocking discovery about their father. Forced to confront unsettling truths about their family's foundation, the duo must decide whether to protect each other or let their escalating friction tear them apart.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Cassie and Max are typical teenage siblings whose relationship is defined by constant banter, sharp wit, and petty rivalries. When their parents leave town for a long weekend, the brother and sister anticipate a quiet few days of unsupervised freedom. However, while searching through their father's private home office for a missing item, they accidentally stumble upon a hidden set of documents and troubling evidence. The discovery uncovers a dark, carefully guarded secret about their father's past that completely shatters their perception of their family. As Cassie and Max try to process what they have found, paranoia and anxiety begin to fuel their existing conflicts. Their usual teenage drama quickly devolves into a psychological tug-of-war as they disagree on how to handle the truth. Tensions mount within the empty house, forcing both siblings to re-examine their loyalty to their parents and to one another. Ultimately, the shared burden of the secret pushes Cassie and Max into an uneasy alliance, forever altering their bond and forcing them to grow up overnight.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: When their parents go out of town for the weekend, teenage siblings Cassie and Max are looking forward to a break from house rules and family obligations. Unsupervised in their suburban home, their habitual sibling rivalry starts up almost immediately, alternating between humorous bickering and emotional tension. However, the dynamics of the house shift dramatically when an accidental discovery in their father's private workspace reveals a shocking secret. As Cassie and Max investigate further, they uncover a side of their family history that threatens everything they thought they knew about their parents. Combining elements of youth comedy, sharp interpersonal drama, and coming-of-age romance, 'Say Less' explores how a single unexpected truth can reshape family bonds and force two reluctant allies to unite against the unknown.

story_structure.climax: Tensions peak in a dramatic confrontation where the siblings must set aside their differences and make a critical choice to protect themselves as the full weight of the truth catches up to them.
story_structure.conflict: The dynamic shifts dramatically when the teenagers stumble upon a hidden, shocking discovery regarding their father, instantly raising the stakes of their isolation.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the harrowing ordeal, Cassie and Max's relationship is permanently altered, leaving them to navigate a new reality and a shared secret that changes how they view their family forever.
story_structure.introduction: Siblings Cassie and Max are left home alone while their parents are away, resuming their usual petty sibling rivalry and banter in an empty house.
story_structure.risingAction: As Cassie and Max try to make sense of what they found, their distrust grows, forced collaboration turns tense, and the true dangers surrounding their family's secrets begin to close in on them.
